content: {"praised":["Cheesy sci‑fi spoofs of 1950s era are spot on.","Homage to 1950s Ed Wood style with many references.","Breakneck pacing keeps viewers riveted.","Captain Jackson’s character adds intrigue for fans.","Mihm’s films are worth a look for genre lovers."],"criticized":["Camera work, dialogue, acting resemble nine‑year‑olds.","Scripts lack depth, need more rehearsal and lessons.","Story jumps too often, confusing some viewers.","Captain Mike Johnson’s arc feels disjointed.","Divisive hero may alienate casual audiences."]}
